parts:
You need to do:

  output$mytable1 <- DT::renderDataTable(

breast, options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 30, 50), pageLength = 10)
 )
Instead of:

output$mytable1 <- DT::renderDataTable({
   DT::datatable(breast, options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 30, 50), pageLength = 10))
 })

Also you have lots of repeated inputId s/ outputId s. You should fix that to.

Here's a working example, though I'd recommend you check out modules to avoid having to remember which ids are already taken:


library(shiny)
library(shinythemes)
library(DT)

cmc <- cars
breast <- faithful
haberman <- pressure

classifier <- tabPanel("Classifier",
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("algochoice1",
        "Select an Algorithm",
        choices = c(

"K Nearest Neighbour (kNN)",
          "Decision Tree",
          "Naive Bayes",
          "Support Vector Machine (SVM)", 
          "Artificial Neural Networks",
          "Fuzzy")
      ),

selectInput("datachoice1",
        "Select a dataset",
        choices = c("Haberman", "CMC", "Breast Cancer")
      ),
      sliderInput("slider1",

"Select Training:Test Dataset ratio",
        1, 99, value = 70, step = 10
      ),

actionButton("action21", "Show", 
        class = "btn-primary", style = ":right"
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("coolplot1"),
      br(),
      br(),
      tableOutput("results1")
    )
  )
)

comparator <- tabPanel("Comparator",
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("datachoice2",
        "Select a dataset",
        choices = c("Haberman", "CMC", "Breast Cancer")
      ),
      sliderInput("slider2",

"Select Training:Test Dataset ratio",
        1, 99, value = 70, step = 10
      ),
radioButtons("typeInput2", "Graph Parameter",

choices = c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Time"),
        selected = "Accuracy"
      ),

actionButton("action22", "Show", 
        class = "btn-primary", style = ":right"
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("coolplot2"),
      br(),
      br(),
      tableOutput("results2")
    )
  )
)
  
dataset <- tabPanel("Dataset",
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("datachoice3", "Select a dataset",
        choices = c("Haberman", "CMC", "Breast Cancer")
      )
    ),
    mainPanel( 
      DT::dataTableOutput('mytable0'),

tabsetPanel(id = 'dataset1',
        tabPanel("Breast Cancer", DT::dataTableOutput('mytable1')),
tabPanel("CMC", DT::dataTableOutput('mytable2')),

tabPanel('Haberman', DT::dataTableOutput('mytable3'))
      )
    )
  )
)
ui <- fluidPage(theme = shinytheme("flatly"),

titlePanel("Medical Data Classifier"),
  navbarPage("Navigation",

classifier,
    comparator,
    dataset
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # output$mytable0 <- DT::renderDataTable(
  #   breast, options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 30, 50), pageLength = 10)
  # )
  output$mytable1 <- DT::renderDataTable(
breast, options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 30, 50), pageLength = 10)

)
  output$mytable2 <- DT::renderDataTable(
cmc, options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 30, 50), pageLength = 5)

)
  output$mytable3 <- DT::renderDataTable(

haberman, options = list(lengthMenu = c(5, 30, 50), pageLength = 10)
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

parts: You don't need to worry about "connection reset by peer", that just means the browser disconnected unexpectedly. But the error above it matters. It is rpart.plot that's throwing the error. I'd start by examining the object you're passing to it and making sure it's correct, and if so, maybe contact the author of the package.
